verdict.rationale: Token2's own docs describe its companion app as managing "FIDO2, PIV, and OTP functionality" on its keys, which implies an OTP feature on the device. Nothing documents TOTP or HOTP slots, how they are configured, or challenge-response. The browser TOTP toolset and the Entra seed export are web utilities, not on-key capabilities, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of on-key TOTP/HOTP slot storage and code generation, challenge-response support, slot configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the key covers legacy one-time-password schemes — TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response — for services that still lack WebAuthn

citations.quote: an all-in-one application designed to manage multiple security features including FIDO2, PIV, and OTP functionality
